Traffic Advisory | MB Road, South Delhi

There will be a temporary traffic diversion & road closure on MB Road from Khanpur T-Point to Hamdard Red Light, Sangam Vihar due to metro construction work tonight (i.e Saturday, 7th February 2026) from 11 pm till 8 am tomorrow (i.e Sunday, 8th February 2026).

During this period, the downline (Saket to Sangam Vihar) traffic will be diverted at Khanpur T Point towards Chirag Delhi, and the upline (Sangam Vihar to Saket) traffic will be diverted from Hamdard Red light towards Ravi Das Marg-Tara Apartment-Govindpuri. The map is attached for reference.

Time: From 11:00 PM, 07.02.2026
To 8:00 AM, 08.02.2026

Please plan your travel accordingly
